Sources: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/inter and https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/notosanssc
These 400/500 font subsets cover the privacy document. Fonts are served locally; reading the page does not contact Google Fonts.
When adding new characters, refresh subsets or retain the declared system-font fallbacks.
